current.generation: Founder POST action create-courtesy-code with raw_code (founder-chosen string, normalized upper/no-space, stored as SHA-256 hash). No random generator.
current.rules: active; redemptions_used < max_redemptions; valid_from <= now; expires_at; eligible_email; eligible_client_id; timing-safe hash compare.
current.overrides: discount_type: PERCENT_100, FULL_CASE_COMP, FIXED_AMOUNT (cents), DIAGNOSIS_ONLY, LABOR_ONLY, SPECIFIC_SERVICE (value cents).
current.waivers: Effectively full comps (PERCENT_100/FULL_CASE_COMP) -> case status COMPLIMENTARY_APPROVED + entitlement {complimentary:true}.
current.client_pricing: Only via eligible_email / eligible_client_id restriction; quotes are per-case founder-authored line items.
current.redemption: completeCheckout(): increments redemptions_used, writes redemption record, audit event COURTESY_CODE_APPLIED; if final total > 0 throws PAYMENT_REQUIRED (no payment provider). previewCourtesyCode for validation.
current.scope: eligible_services column default ['EXISTING_LOCATION'] but validateCourtesyForQuote never checks it; service-specific by construction only.
current.audit: case_events audit() in memory; created_by + founder_note on code; redemptions table (schema).
current.ui: Client: courtesy code input on existing-location checkout. Founder: NONE — API only; SITE00_ROUTES.existingLocationAdmin constant has no mounted admin route/page.
current.persistence_note: Service uses in-memory Maps (api/_lib/existingLocation/memoryStore.ts); no code reads/writes site00_courtesy_* tables. Codes vanish on Railway restart.
